# Vendored libraries (MIT licensed), used only by the optional Live student view (watch.js)
- peerjs 1.5.5 (peerjs.min.js): browser-to-browser data connection (the free PeerJS cloud server only introduces the two browsers; the screen data goes directly between them).
- rrweb 2.0.0-alpha.17 (rrweb.umd.min.js, rrweb.min.css): records and replays what is on a web page.
